asked.item: why the dental brand channel does not appear when connecting YouTube
Manager role shown in YouTube Studio
what to do to get the channel to show

verdict.reason: The help pages state that a channel where the user is only a Manager may not appear when connecting, and give the fix of getting the Owner role and then reconnecting.

steps.text: If you are listed only as a Manager on the brand channel, the channel may not appear when connecting.
Ask the current Owner to make you an Owner of the channel, or to transfer ownership to you.
After that, reconnect the channel in Blotato.
